name: Render Template
description: Renders a Mustache template to a destination file.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.label: Destination path
parameters.help: The file rendered on the managed host, e.g. /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.

parameters.name: template_content
parameters.label: Template content
parameters.help: Mustache: {{{vars.<namespace>:vars.<name>}}} inserts a variable (triple braces: not HTML-escaped), {{#classes.<namespace>:<class>}}…{{/classes.<namespace>:<class>}} keeps a section only while the class is set. It's saved as its own .mustache file next to the policy, used as written: $(name) isn't expanded there, use {{{vars.…}}}.
